description: This file contains test cases for a FastAPI application, utilizing pytest and the fastapi.testclient module to test various API endpoints with different header scenarios and response validations.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Fixture to dynamically import a module based on test parameters and create a TestClient for the app defined in that module.

methods.name: test_get_no_headers_items(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests that accessing /items/ without headers returns a 422 error with missing header details.

methods.name: test_get_no_headers_users(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests that accessing /users/ without headers returns a 422 error with missing header details.

methods.name: test_get_invalid_one_header_items(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests invalid X-Token header for /items/ endpoint returning a 400 error.

methods.name: test_get_invalid_one_users(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests invalid X-Token header for /users/ endpoint returning a 400 error.

methods.name: test_get_invalid_second_header_items(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests invalid X-Key header in combination with valid X-Token for /items/ endpoint, expecting a 400 error.

methods.name: test_get_invalid_second_header_users(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests invalid X-Key header with valid X-Token for /users/ endpoint, expecting a 400 error.

methods.name: test_get_valid_headers_items(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests successful GET request to /items/ with valid headers, expecting a 200 response with items list.

methods.name: test_get_valid_headers_users(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests successful GET request to /users/ with valid headers, expecting a 200 response with users list.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Validates the OpenAPI schema at /openapi.json for correctness and completeness.
